title: The Nature of Man and the Revelation of the Father
english: Regarding such wars, it is as if the fingers and hands of a man were skillfully touching the defenses, through which one might strike and wound the evil men and demons who are protectors of wickedness and false knowledge. Ps 143:4.

The composition of men from a corruptible body and an immortal soul, joined together, possesses according to the immortal and spiritual soul a thought and knowledge of the cause of all things; but according to the body, it is nothing, being like the moving and bright shadow of a man's daily life. Ps 143:4.

Yet although the power of the soul is spiritual, it is not reckoned as a god by chance, but by providing good things to God itself. For it is not said, 'What is man, that he should know you and think about you,' but, 'That you were known and you think about him.' For the Savior makes himself manifest to those prepared for this, and by this it is said that they know him. Having been known also according to spiritual contemplation, having been seen, he shows also the Father to be seen by the same. For 'He who has seen me has seen the Father,' and 'No one knows the Father except the Son and whomsoever the Son wills to reveal.' Since, therefore, the Son, possessing the Father within himself, shows Him to be seen by the same, so also the Father, possessing the Son within himself, reveals Him to him who wishes to have knowledge not through flesh and blood but from God. Ps 143:5,6.

And the following things are able to signify the coming of the Savior from Mary, who, having bent the heavens which are His handiwork, descended because He was to come forth from her. Since, therefore, having descended, He overturned the invisible demons who are harmful and filthy to men with all their host, through which they are called 'decaying' because they see themselves as arrogant and lofty. Since, therefore, the things being purified and made bright are not gold and silver by the striking of fire upon them, but...
by the fire that has come to be cast upon the earth
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
